title: timebomb and sword spam
features: works on any no cooldown doomspire brickbattle game
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local function loopTool(tool)
	if tool:GetAttribute("Looping") then
		return
	end
	tool:SetAttribute("Looping", true)
	task.spawn(function()
		while tool.Parent == player.Character do
			tool:Activate()
			task.wait(0.05) 
		end
		tool:SetAttribute("Looping", false)
	end)
end
local function checkTool(tool)
	if tool:IsA("Tool") and (tool.Name == "Sword" or tool.Name == "Timebomb") then
		loopTool(tool)
	end
end
local function setupCharacter(character)
	character.ChildAdded:Connect(checkTool)
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		checkTool(obj)
	end
end
if player.Character then
	setupCharacter(player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)
